job.title: Customer Success Manager (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware exp mandatory)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Specialist | Stakeholder Management & Enterprise Platform Success
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years of experience partnering with business stakeholders and engineering teams across enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record driving digital commerce outcomes through business requirements analysis, gap analysis, user stories, process mapping, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Skilled in bridging technical architectures with commercial objectives, production troubleshooting, and cross-functional stakeholder management in international agile environments. Holds SAP Commerce Developer and Business User certifications.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager (Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Demandware exp mandatory)
cover_en.hook: Salesforce is renowned for empowering global brands to deliver exceptional digital commerce experiences, making this Customer Success role an exciting opportunity. Bringing 5+ years of hands-on enterprise e-commerce platform delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in translating complex technical architectures into measurable business outcomes.

bullets.label: Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Worked directly in techno-functional roles with business stakeholders, translating commercial priorities into functional specifications, user stories, and actionable solution designs.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Operations
bullets.text: Delivered scalable B2B and B2C commerce solutions, optimizing order management, product catalogs, and critical business workflows for global enterprises.

bullets.label: UAT & Production Reliability
bullets.text: Facilitated user acceptance testing (UAT), resolved cross-system integration bottlenecks, and supported production issue mitigation to protect platform uptime and business continuity.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated across international engineering teams and commercial product owners within agile frameworks, utilizing AI tools to accelerate documentation and project delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional e-commerce background can drive value for your customers.

tailoring.why_company: Salesforce defines industry leadership in cloud customer success and digital commerce transformation. I admire how Salesforce equips organizations to maximize business value through robust platform ecosystems. Contributing my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience to advocate for clients, resolve platform bottlenecks, and drive successful customer adoption aligns directly with my passion for techno-functional consulting.
tailoring.motivation_short: Dedicated to driving digital commerce value, I bridge technical architectures and commercial success through 5+ years of enterprise platform delivery, stakeholder management, and proactive solution consulting.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi! With 5+ yrs in enterprise e-commerce platforms driving techno-functional delivery, stakeholder alignment, and UAT at Shell & Rockwell, I would love to connect regarding the Customer Success role at Salesforce. Notice ends 15.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Customer Success Manager – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Customer Success Manager position at Salesforce.

With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in bridging technical platforms with commercial objectives through requirements engineering, stakeholder alignment, and production reliability. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing how I can support your customers' success.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
